text.en:
The Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office shall hereby be
placed under the supervision and control of the Department of Health.
Executive Order No. 520, series of 2006, is hereby
repealed. All other orders, issuances, rules and regulations or parts thereof

inconsistent with this Executive Order are hereby repealed or modified
accordingly.

This Executive Order shall take effect immediately.
DONE in the City of Manila, this 8th day of May
Lord, Two Thousand and Seven.
in the vear of our
By the President:
EDUARDO R. ERMITA
Executive Secretary
